name: @lacspace/monorepo
description: Lacspace open-source TypeScript packages (api, auth, analytics, sdk).

scripts.build: npm -w @lacspace/api run build && npm -w @lacspace/auth run build && npm -w @lacspace/analytics run build && npm -w @lacspace/sdk run build
scripts.publish:all: npm -w @lacspace/api publish --access public && npm -w @lacspace/auth publish --access public && npm -w @lacspace/analytics publish --access public && npm -w @lacspace/sdk publish --access public
